THE BEGINNING

Several days ago, something happened that humanity cannot explain.

A massive object struck Earth near the city of Malevorn, Ohio.

There was no warning.

No approaching asteroid had been detected. No satellite imagery recorded its arrival. No military tracking systems registered an incoming object.

It was almost as if the thing had simply appeared in Earth’s atmosphere.

The impact devastated the surrounding area. But the destruction itself was only the beginning.

Something emerged from the ruins.

Something that would eventually be known as LEGION.

Nobody knows what Legion actually is. An extraterrestrial intelligence? A demonic presence? An ancient cosmic organism? Perhaps something that exists beyond the categories humanity uses to understand reality.

Whatever it is, it has one apparent purpose:

TO CORRUPT THE LIVING WORLD AND ERADICATE HUMANITY.
THE LEGION

Legion is not simply a creature. It is a powerful, seemingly intelligent phenomenon capable of spreading its influence through living organisms.

Animals, humans, and other forms of life exposed to its presence begin to change.

Their bodies mutate. Their minds deteriorate. Their identities disappear.

Those who survive the transformation become something else.

They become SCOURGEN.

Scourgen are mutated, possessed organisms connected through a collective hive mind. They are no longer independent individuals. They operate as extensions of Legion, responding to its influence and hunting anything that remains uncorrupted.

Not all transformations are alike.

Some become aggressive hunters. Others develop unnatural strength, speed, or biological adaptations. Some appear to possess abilities that defy conventional biology.

And there are things emerging from the darkness that may never have been human to begin with.

The full extent of Legion’s influence remains unknown.

MARTCO #004

Malevorn is falling.

Emergency broadcasts have become increasingly unreliable. Communications are disappearing. Entire neighborhoods have gone silent.

And somewhere in the middle of the chaos sits MARTCO Super Store #004.

A familiar place. Fluorescent lights. Shopping carts. Grocery aisles. Refrigerators humming in the distance.

The store is supposed to be open twenty-four hours.

Tonight, however, the doors are locked.

The power is unstable. The lights flicker. Shelves have been overturned, merchandise is scattered across the floors, and strange noises echo through the building.

The public-address system continues to operate.

Occasionally, it makes announcements.

Some sound almost normal.

Others don’t.

SURVIVOR 001 — THE EMPLOYEE

COLT — AGE 26 • HEIGHT 5′11″

Colt is an ordinary retail associate working at MARTCO #004.

He isn’t a soldier. He isn’t a trained operative. He has no special knowledge of extraterrestrial biology, military tactics, or the phenomenon spreading across Malevorn.

He’s just a guy who happened to be working late.

When everything went wrong, Colt was the last employee inside the store.

Now he’s alone.

Or at least, he was.

With the outside world collapsing and something hunting him inside the building, Colt has only a few things to rely on:

A Mosin-Nagant rifle. A flashlight. Whatever supplies he can find. And the determination to make it through the night.

SURVIVOR 002 — THE CUSTOMER

JUSTINE — AGE 22 • HEIGHT 5′2″

MARTCO PERSONNEL ARCHIVE • UNAUTHORIZED ACCESS

SUBJECT: JUSTINE • STATUS: ALIVE — UNCONFIRMED
CLASS: CIVILIAN • KNOWN WEAPON: MOSIN-NAGANT M44 CARBINE

Justine was an ordinary customer at MARTCO #004 on the night of the Malevorn incident. She only came in late for a few things.

When the outbreak began, she was trapped inside the store with several other people. Separated from them, she survived by hiding in the back corridors.

At some point she acquired a Mosin-Nagant M44 carbine. How she obtained it remains unclear.

Unlike Colt, Justine has no documented connection to MARTCO.

Subject shows unusual resourcefulness and an apparent willingness to engage infected organisms at close range. Do not underestimate her.

END OF AVAILABLE RECORD. SOME CUSTOMERS NEVER LEAVE.

YOUR SHIFT BEGINS AT 10:00 PM

Your objective is simple:

SURVIVE UNTIL 6:00 AM.

Eight hours stand between you and daylight.

Unfortunately, the night isn’t going to make it easy.

The Scourgen are inside the store. More continue to arrive. The lights will fail. The building itself may become dangerous.

And at approximately 3:00 AM, something considerably worse is expected to enter the building.

It is known as THE DRAGONAUT.

Do not mistake it for an ordinary Scourgen.

When it screams, its chest opens. That may be your only opportunity to hurt it.

If you survive until 6:00 AM, you will have accomplished something remarkable.

But don’t assume the nightmare ends there.

EMPLOYEE SURVIVAL HANDBOOK

A few recommendations from management:

  • CONSERVE AMMUNITION. Your Mosin-Nagant holds five rounds. Make them count.
  • WATCH YOUR SURROUNDINGS. Not everything approaches from the floor.
  • PRESERVE YOUR LIGHT. Your flashlight battery is limited.
  • SEARCH THE STORE. Supplies may be scattered throughout the building.
  • LISTEN TO THE ANNOUNCEMENTS. The PA system may provide information. It may also be completely insane.
  • DO NOT APPROACH THE DRAGONAUT CARELESSLY.
  • PLEASE REMAIN CALM. Management is aware of the situation. Management is unavailable at this time.
